definition: to go well with something else
description: A mirror selfie in a hotel corridor. A young woman with long dark curly hair spins in a burgundy top and skirt, and her outfit turns into a top and short skirt with a pink flamingo and green palm-leaf print exactly like the flamingo wallpaper behind her, so she almost blends into the wall. She smiles, takes photos with her phone and poses in pink heeled sandals. Behind her a porter in a burgundy uniform peeks out from beside a brass luggage trolley and stares. There is a green carpet, a gold wall lamp and a potted palm.

en.question: What does her new outfit match?
